contract: Durable SQLite job queue for actual saved sketch PNG export. Existing SDK BackgroundWorker driver and native application supervisor grant boundary; canonical artifacts only. Optimistic state revisions protect cancellation/retry, events retain attempt outputs/errors, request IDs deduplicate submission. Process boot/start identity recovers dead workers without treating live workers as lost. API, tools, and console share bound queue.
acceptance: Real rendering pixels, SQL concurrency, process death recovery, granted/denied SDK subprocess execution, HTTP/tool queue operations, immutable cancellation outputs, CAS conflicts, UI rendering. Full supervisor boot/browser journey remains integrated qualification.
remaining_limits: Only real local sketch_export is supported; no external provider or GPU result claimed
Browser interaction and full supervisor installation/boot require root integrated qualification
Canonical artifact root locks are process-local; concurrent synchronous and worker rendering of the same sketch revision is not globally serialized
Linux proc identity recovery; other platforms not qualified
